meta.title: Solutions | SGS International — Sectors & Capabilities
meta.description: SGS turnkey solutions across solar PV, industrial water treatment, and civil infrastructure, supported by integrated EPC, commissioning, O&M, quality, and HSE capabilities.

hero.title: Turnkey solutions across our three core sectors
hero.text: Single-source EPC and O&M delivery for solar PV, water treatment, and civil infrastructure — water proven, the others ready.

solutions.title: Full EPC and O&M for utility-scale and distributed solar PV
solutions.text: We offer complete solar PV delivery — engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and O&M — backed by the project delivery systems proven across our water treatment plants.

solutions.title: Our proven, delivered sector — 5 plants in Qatar
solutions.text: Engineering, construction, commissioning, and O&M of industrial water treatment plants — coagulation, multimedia and activated carbon filtration, and sludge handling — delivered to discharge standard.

solutions.title: Turnkey civil delivery from foundations to handover
solutions.text: Site works, foundations, reinforced concrete structures, and pre-engineered steel buildings — delivered with the same quality and HSE systems proven on our water projects.

solutions.title: Integrated EPC delivery under one accountable contract
solutions.text: Multidiscipline engineering, procurement, and construction aligned inside a single delivery framework, with project management and cross-border sourcing.

solutions.title: Start-up to steady-state performance through to handover
solutions.text: Commissioning, performance testing, operations, and maintenance — keeping assets running to specification and supported through to handover.

solutions.title: Quality and HSE systems built into every project
solutions.text: QA/QC, inspection, testing, and HSE management applied consistently across solar PV, water, and civil infrastructure delivery.
